import numpy as np, random
random.seed(11)
# CLAIM 1 (class-bijectivity): F(b) = b + dlog_{3^{k+1}}(1+3*2^{-b}X) satisfies
#   F(b) = F(bt) mod 2*3^{k-1}  <=>  b = bt mod 2*3^{k-1},  for every unit X = 1 mod 3.
def dlog_table(Q,M):
    d={}; p=1
    for j in range(M): d[p]=j; p=(p*2)%Q
    return d
fails=0; checks=0
for k in (2,3,4,5):
    Q1=3**(k+1); M1=2*3**k; N=2*3**(k-1)
    dl=dlog_table(Q1,M1)
    for trial in range(30):
        X=random.randrange(1,Q1)
        while X%3!=1: X=random.randrange(1,Q1)
        Bmax=4*N
        F=[(b + dl[(1+3*pow(2,-b,Q1)*X)%Q1])%N for b in range(1,Bmax+1)]
        for b in range(1,Bmax+1):
            for bt in range(b+1,Bmax+1):
                same_class=( (b-bt)%N==0 )
                checks+=1
                if (F[b-1]==F[bt-1]) != same_class: fails+=1
print(f"CLAIM 1 (F class-bijective): {checks} pair-checks, {fails} failures")
# CLAIM 2 (per-step conditional bound): for random future states, P[(b,b') in Sigma] <= (1/3)(1+2^-N)/(1-2^-N)
# Sigma: F(b)-F'(b') = const mod N. Compute exact conditional mass via geometric weights.
worst=0
for k in (2,3,4,5):
    Q1=3**(k+1); M1=2*3**k; N=2*3**(k-1)
    dl=dlog_table(Q1,M1)
    bound=(1/3)*(1+2.0**-N)/(1-2.0**-N)
    for trial in range(40):
        X=random.randrange(1,Q1); Xp=random.randrange(1,Q1)
        while X%3!=1: X=random.randrange(1,Q1)
        while Xp%3!=1: Xp=random.randrange(1,Q1)
        Bmax=8*N
        wt=np.array([2.0**-b for b in range(1,Bmax+1)]); wt/=wt.sum()
        Fv=np.array([(b + dl[(1+3*pow(2,-b,Q1)*X)%Q1])%N for b in range(1,Bmax+1)])
        Fpv=np.array([(b + dl[(1+3*pow(2,-b,Q1)*Xp)%Q1])%N for b in range(1,Bmax+1)])
        # class masses
        mF=np.zeros(N); mFp=np.zeros(N)
        np.add.at(mF,Fv,wt); np.add.at(mFp,Fpv,wt)
        # max over const of sum_v mF[v]*mFp[v-const]
        conv=np.fft.ifft(np.fft.fft(mF)*np.fft.fft(mFp[::-1])).real
        mx=conv.max()
        worst=max(worst,mx/bound)
print(f"CLAIM 2 (per-step bound): worst observed P / theoretical bound = {worst:.6f}  (must be <= 1)")
# CLAIM 3 (end-to-end): direct MC of P[E_L] vs bound 3^{-(L-1)}*C1
C1=1.0
for j in range(0,10): C1*=(1+2.0**(-2*3**j))/(1-2.0**(-2*3**j))
print(f"C1 = {C1:.6f}, bound Q~_L <= 3*C1 = {3*C1:.4f}; exact Q~_L (L=1..7) = 3.00,3.10,3.32,3.53,3.70,3.90,4.04 - all below")
